title: CreateCategoryRequest
description: Native Contract v2 request for creating one user-defined Category. The C++ Application/Domain writer is the sole canonicalization owner; Flutter and Kotlin validate the wire shape and forward every schema-valid value unchanged.

x-normalization-rules.name: Trim Unicode boundary whitespace, then reject blank or more than 40 Unicode code points.
x-normalization-rules.description: Trim Unicode boundary whitespace; map whitespace-only input to null; reject canonical text longer than 200 Unicode code points.
x-normalization-rules.icon: Trim Unicode boundary whitespace; map whitespace-only input to null; reject canonical text longer than 64 Unicode code points.

name.description: Schema-valid leading and trailing whitespace is forwarded unchanged; C++ produces the canonical trimmed name.

description.description: Optional user note. Null is preserved; a non-empty schema-valid string is forwarded unchanged. C++ trims it and maps whitespace-only input to null.

color.description: Required RGB color. Lowercase hex is a valid wire value; C++ persists and returns the canonical uppercase #RRGGBB form.

icon.description: Optional stable icon key. Null is preserved; a non-empty schema-valid string is forwarded unchanged. C++ trims it and maps whitespace-only input to null.

sort_order.description: Optional explicit order in the exact cross-language JSON integer range 0..9007199254740991. Null asks C++ to append deterministically; if the active maximum is already 9007199254740991, creation fails with CATEGORY_SORT_ORDER_EXHAUSTED and writes nothing.
